state_machine.paper: under paper trial; no stakes, no rewards
state_machine.live: promotion gates passed (engine's qualified tier); stakes allowed only inside the registered plan
state_machine.paper (demoted): returned by a gate trigger; re-promotion restarts the full promotion path and counts as a new trial

triggers.name: Signal collapse
triggers.rule: One-sided binomial P(X <= observed wins | n window, declared baseline) <= 0.01 over the last 20 graded selections (minimum 10 to evaluate).

triggers.name: Repeated failure
triggers.rule: Two consecutive windows both evaluate at P <= 0.05 against the declared baseline; fires even when neither window alone reached the D1 threshold.

triggers.name: Calibration drift
triggers.rule: Window mean Brier exceeds the promotion-time Brier by 0.05 or more (0.25 is the no-information reference).

triggers.name: Integrity breach
triggers.rule: Any settlement number in the graded record is not traceable to a registered official source.
triggers.effect: immediate demotion; affected selections quarantined pending re-verification

triggers.name: Governance breach
triggers.rule: Any stake placed outside the pre-registered staking plan recorded at promotion.
triggers.effect: immediate demotion; plan must be re-registered before re-promotion

evaluation_rule: runs after every graded round while a strategy is live; the first firing trigger is recorded with its window

applied_to.because: nothing has reached the engine's qualified tier and no executable price exists (RG03/RG10), so nothing is live
